blocks.text:
Arrival in Lima, meeting at the airport with a guide and transfer to the hotel; after check-in, a half-day city tour. Peru’s capital and largest city, on the Pacific coast, was founded in 1535 by Francisco Pizarro as the “Ciudad de los Reyes” (City of Kings); its historic centre is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the city is home to great cultural diversity and many museums.

The guided tour visits the main colonial sights: the Main Square with the Cathedral, the San Francisco Convent and many elegant buildings with restored traditional wooden balconies. Continue to the residential districts of San Isidro, with its Olive Grove, Country Club and golf course, and Miraflores, with its Central Park, City Hall and shopping streets such as Avenida Larco, ending with a visit to the Larco Museum. Return to the hotel.
The lights of Lima's coastal buildings above the ocean at dusk, Peru
